title: How we make money
body:
Snapped Up is free to read. We pay for it through **affiliate links**.

When you click a "See deal" button or a retailer link and then buy something, the retailer may pay us a small commission. **You pay exactly the same price** as you would going direct.

## What that does and doesn't mean

- Commission never decides what we feature. We pick deals on price and value first.
- We don't accept payment to include a product or to write a positive verdict.
- Links to retailers on this site should be assumed to be affiliate links.

## Programmes we're part of

Snapped Up is a participant in the Amazon EU Associates Programme, an affiliate advertising programme designed to provide a means for sites to earn advertising fees by advertising and linking to Amazon.co.uk. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.

We also work with the eBay Partner Network and retailers through the Awin affiliate network.

## Prices

Prices and stock change quickly, sometimes within minutes. Every price on this site was correct when we published it, but please check the retailer's page before you buy.
